scope: Actual offline ARM execution of JSON numeric helpers in saved baseline and current assembled Base, GCSV and GCSV-yield blobs. No camera access, deployment or source mutation.

execution.mode: Explicitly escalated offline command because sandboxed Unicorn probe could not execute JIT code

original_stdout: base baseline/current helpers identical and expected; ABI/odd guards pass 426
gcsv baseline/current helpers identical and expected; ABI/odd guards pass 426
gcsv-yield baseline/current helpers identical and expected; ABI/odd guards pass 426
execution.replay_script_validation: AST syntax check passed; the completed ARM batch was not repeated after persisting the replay script

assertions: Baseline and candidate output bytes equal an independent Python decimal oracle
ji prints the full unsigned value
jm prints unsigned thousandths with exactly three fractional digits
jhalf prints floor(value/2) followed by .0 or .5
All calls return within the instruction limit
Output cursor r9 remains within the declared output region
Three leading sentinel bytes and every byte after the returned cursor remain unchanged
r4-r11 are preserved except r9, which is the documented JSON output cursor
SP is restored; strict harness also checks 8-byte stack alignment at ARM calls
ji preserves its caller's r1 value 0xDEADBEEF
Execution outside the assembled blob or declared strict native stubs fails

prior_unavailable_attempts.result: Unavailable in the sandbox; not counted as a passing ARM test
prior_unavailable_attempts.resolution: The explicitly escalated offline command subsequently executed every reported helper case

not_covered: Full gcsv_json_write firmware interactions and complete lens profile generation

independent_assembly_checks.coverage: Length table extracted from actual assembled bytes: all binary interval endpoints, powers-of-ten boundaries, 100000 random uint32 values
independent_assembly_checks.notes: All four decoded ADR instructions target their exact assembled symbols in each edition. These arithmetic/ADR checks were separate from the 1278 ARM helper cases.
